evidence: X-Ray structure determinations reveal that all the complexes studied are monomeric. The chemical shifts observed for the pentamethylcyclopentadienyl rings are the same for all complexes 2–5 while the Lewis base ligands give peaks at the same positions and forms as seen for the pure neutral ligands. Thermogravimetric analysis were carried out on a Mettler Toledo Stare system equipped with a TGA 850 thermobalance using a flowing nitrogen atmosphere at 1 atm. 1H and 13C NMR spectra were recorded with a Varian Gemini 2000 instrument at ambient temperature. Mass spectra were recorded with a JEOL JMS-SX102 operating in electron impact mode (70 eV) using a direct insertion probe. The structures were solved with the SIR97 program and further refinements were carried out using the SHELXL-97 software package.
